item.title: Version 1.22.1
item.description:
New

- Device frames - Add device bezels (iPhone, MacBook, etc.) around your recordings with auto-detection of device type and automatic video placement - Recording region overlay - Pulsing red outline shows the area being recorded while capturing - Pause/play during recording - Pause and resume your screen recording mid-capture - Click animations in export - Visual click indicators appear in your final video - Optional mode for zooms - New zoom behavior option

Improved

- Zoom editor/viewer - Enhanced interface for editing and viewing zooms - Device frame rendering - Better shadow effects, precise sizing, and cached bezel loading for performance - Window picker - Simplified to visual picker only (removed grid mode)

Fixed

- Cursor no longer tracked when clicking the recording overlay - Hotfix to include new device frames
